descriptions.zh: 随着在§Y[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!上安装了[GetStartingDrive]，我们的工程[GetCrew]已完成对方舟舰上的老化系统的全面检查，以为真正的星际旅行做准备。目前已在舰船各处发现多处故障。
descriptions.en: With the installation of the [GetStartingDrive] aboard the §Y[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!, our engineering [GetCrew] have completed a comprehensive inspection of the Arkship's aging systems in preparation for true interstellar travel. Numerous faults have been identified throughout the vessel.

descriptions.zh: 护盾诊断显示有几个发射器未对准，需要重新校准。
descriptions.en: Shield diagnostics indicate several projectors are misaligned and require recalibration.

descriptions.zh: 一个来自未经探索的恒星系的信号，已开始在我们的通信数据库中自我复制。
descriptions.en: A signal originating from an unexplored star system has begun replicating itself across our communications databanks.

descriptions.zh: 多个传感器阵列检测到持续的干涉模式。
descriptions.en: Persistent interference patterns have been detected across multiple sensor arrays.

descriptions.zh: 腐蚀性冷却液泄漏正在危及船体完整性。
descriptions.en: Corrosive coolant leaks are compromising hull integrity.

descriptions.zh: 多个机库早已被改作仓库之用，限制了我方机组人员的作战备勤能力。
descriptions.en: Multiple hangar bays have long since been repurposed as storage, limiting the operational readiness of our flight crews.

descriptions.zh: 方舟舰的开采系统尚未在实际运行条件下进行过测试。资源勘探表明，周边星系中存在具有开采价值的矿藏。
descriptions.en: The Arkship's extraction systems have yet to be tested under operational conditions. Resource surveys indicate viable deposits in the surrounding systems.

descriptions.zh: 若要使方舟舰恢复到完全备战状态，就必须修理好这些缺陷。
descriptions.en: These deficiencies must be corrected if the Arkship is to be restored to full operational readiness.

descriptions.en:
Ah, a familiar contender returns to the Broadcast! But are you packing any new heat?

Our audience, and the galactic arena await!

Would you like to be the main event?

descriptions.zh:
欢迎加入冠铸秀！这里是铸就传奇的摇篮，也是星际梦想启航的地方。我们漫游于星辰之间，为这个厌倦了安逸与平庸的星系提供惊险与盛况。

你的杀手锏是什么？是身手敏捷的飞行员？是令人震撼的火力？还是单纯对利润和掌声的渴望？立即报名，我们将把你塑造成一颗璀璨之星。
descriptions.en:
Welcome to CFL! This is where legends are forged, and stellar dreams take flight. We roam the stars, providing danger and spectacle to a galaxy grown bored of safety and routine.

What's your angle? Nimble pilots? Spectacular firepower? Or simply a taste for profit and applause? Sign up today, and we'll turn you into a star.

descriptions.zh:
欢迎收看“冠军之铸”现场秀！这里是全星系最顶尖的视觉与毁灭盛宴。

位于§Y[champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§!星系的下一届冠铸秀现已开放报名。一场壮丽的大乱斗正等待着大家。

想要锻造属于你的传奇？那就报名参赛。

想要安宁与清静？没门！

Registration is now open for the next CFL Tournament in the §Y[champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§! System. A glorious free-for-all awaits.

Entry requirement: a fleet of at most §H[champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement] Fleet Size§!.

Victors take the rewards, the prestige, and the grand CFL trophy.

You want to forge a legend? Sign up.

You want peace and quiet? Too bad!

descriptions.zh:
“星系各地的岩石生物、有机生命和战争机器们——欢迎回到‘冠军之铸’锦标赛的直播现场！

§Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§!星系的闲杂人等已经清理完毕，赌池也正炙手可热，我有一种预感，我们即将亲眼见证一些造价极其高昂的硬件烧毁报废。

各位屏幕前的观众请记住：这可不是什么例行巡逻或边界摩擦。这里是铸炉！没人能带着完整的尊严撤离。

参赛者们……创造！传奇！吧！”
descriptions.en:
"LITHOIDS, ORGANICS, AND WAR MACHINES ACROSS THE GALAXY - WELCOME BACK TO CHAMPION'S FORGE LIVE!

The §Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§! system has been cleared, the betting pools are on fire, and I've got a feeling we're about to witness some incredibly expensive hardware go critical.

Remember, everyone at home: this isn't just some patrol or border skirmish. This is the Forge! Nobody retreats with their pride intact.

Contestants... MAKE! IT! LEGENDARY!"

descriptions.zh:
狂热的混战终于在§Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§!星系平息下来。铸炉熄灭了。残骸在渐冷的星光中漂流，应急信标断断续续地重新亮起。

“多么壮观的场面！”冠铸秀解说员嘶吼着，声音因真情流露而变得沙哑。“这就是我们来的目的！这就是全星系观众拭目以待的时刻！”

第三名并不可耻，这恰恰证明了我们有资格站在转播镜头前。即便身处领奖台的最底层，我们依然可以俯视那些被我们击溃的舰队。
descriptions.en:
The frenzied melee finally falls quiet in the §Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§! system. The Forge goes dark. Wreckage drifts through cooling light as emergency beacons stutter back to life.

"What a spectacle!" the CFL commentator roars, voice raw with unfeigned emotion. "That's what we came for! That's what the galaxy tuned in to see!"

Third place is no shame, only proof we belonged on the broadcast. Even at the lowest step of the podium, we can look down on the fleets we broke.

label.zh: 我们的舰队飞行得很好！

第一名！在全星系的崇拜目光中，我们从冠铸秀组委会手中夺走了奖杯并将其高高举起。这次胜利的余响将远传至赛场之外。

现在，整个星系都将对我们的舰队心生畏惧。

"What a spectacle!" the CFL commentator roars, voice raw with unfeigned emotion. "That's what we came for! That's what the galaxy tuned in to see!"

First place! Bathed in the galaxy's adoration, we tore the trophy from the CFL crew and raised it high. This victory will echo far beyond the arena.

Now the galaxy knows to fear our fleets.

我们没有获得名次。奖杯上不会刻下我们的名字，观众们也将转向更耀眼的明星。我们必须回去。

The frenzied melee finally falls quiet in the §Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§! system. The Forge goes dark. Wreckage drifts through cooling light as emergency beacons stutter back to life.

"What a spectacle!" the CFL commentator roars, voice raw with unfeigned emotion. "That's what we came for! That's what the galaxy tuned in to see!"

We did not place. The trophy will not carry our name, and the crowd will move on to brighter stars. We have to return.

label.zh: 谁会在乎这种无意义的比赛？
label.en: Who even cares about a pointless contest?

descriptions.zh:
§Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§!恒星系内的比赛局势胶着、难解难分。舰队濒临崩溃彼此追逐环绕，无人能打出决定性一击。

但没有胜利的结局，没有人举起奖杯，也没有人登上领奖台。冠军之铸团队终于承认：无法确定胜者。参赛队伍被遣散回家，转播悄然切回重播。
descriptions.en:
The match in the §Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§! system dragged on without resolution. Battered fleets circled one another, none able to land the deciding blow.

But there is no triumphant finish, no trophy raised, no podium. The CFL crew finally call it: no winner could be determined. The contestant fleets are released and sent home, the broadcast quietly cut to a rerun.

Their final "spectacle" was quite profitable... for us.

Our names will forever be the final ones inscribed on the trophy... and with those fools at the CFL gone, there will be no next champion to challenge our claim.

label.zh: 星系总会找到新的乐子。向来如此。
label.en: The galaxy will find new entertainment. It always does.

descriptions.en:
For a few seconds, the galaxy is treated to CFL's final show.

A shaky feed with a screaming commentator followed by wall of fire swallowing the Arkship.

Then: cut to black.

The Champion's Forge Live! Enclave has been destroyed by §Y[champions_forge_destroyer.GetName]§! in the §Y[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]§! system.

画面剧烈晃动，伴随着解说员的尖叫，随后一堵火墙吞噬了方舟舰。

接着：画面切断。

冠军之铸现场秀！位于§Y[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]§!星系的太空城邦被§Y[champions_forge_destroyer.GetName]§!摧毁。

我们的名字将永远是刻在奖杯上的最后一批……随着冠铸秀的消亡，再也不会有新的冠军来挑战我们的地位了。
descriptions.en:
For a few seconds, the galaxy is treated to CFL's final show.

A shaky feed with a screaming commentator followed by wall of fire swallowing the Arkship.

Then: cut to black.

The Champion's Forge Live! Enclave has been destroyed by §Y[champions_forge_destroyer.GetName]§! in the §Y[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]§! system.

Our names will forever be the final ones inscribed on the trophy... and with the CFL gone, there will be no new champion to challenge our claim.

label.zh: 星系总会找到新的乐子。向来如此。
label.en: The galaxy will find new entertainment. It always does.

options.script: name = nomads.410.a

descriptions.zh:
自从我们流亡以来，我们一直在等待追踪探针的出现。赏金猎人紧随其后，他们的目标正是§Y[capital_scope.GetName]§!。让我们在流放中死去正合篡位者的心意。

我们要让他们失望了。
descriptions.en:
Ever since we were exiled, we have waited for the pursuing ping to appear. There are bounty hunters on our tail and they have the §Y[capital_scope.GetName]§! in their sights. Our death in exile would suit the usurper.

We will have to disappoint them.

descriptions.zh:
我们再次击败了篡位者的爪牙。他们不会停止进犯，且下一次会变得更加凶猛。但是如果我们能摧毁足够多的敌人，或许连他们也会明白，想要抹除我们并非易事。

只要[capital_scope.GetName]仍在飘扬，我们的宣称就依然有效。我们要让他们知道，有些传承绝不会消亡。
descriptions.en:
We have defeated the agents of the usurper once more. They will not stop coming, and next time they will be stronger. If we break enough of them, perhaps even they will learn that we are not so easily erased.

As long as [capital_scope.GetName] flies, so too does our claim. We will teach them that some legacies refuse to die.

descriptions.zh: “住手！你的驾驶机动水平已经证明了你确实是个真正的掠夺者，被放逐又如何。今天我们不会为所谓的荣誉而付出更多代价。开个价，饶我们一命吧。”[Root.GetSpeciesName]在§Y[From.GetName]§!上喊道，身边是毁坏的舰桥。
descriptions.en: "Stand down! Your piloting makes you a true Marauder, exile be damned. We will not trade more plating for pride today. Name the fee to spare us." The [Root.GetSpeciesName] on the §Y[From.GetName]§! hails from a ruptured bridge.

descriptions.zh:
被我们击败的敌方舰队很快就发出了投降信号。

“也打够了，这次是你们占了上风。现在，你要我们交出什么，好让我们能清洗船上的这个小污点，继续前进。”
descriptions.en:
The hostile fleet we defeated quickly signaled their surrender.

"That's enough of that. You've the better of us this time. Now, what must we hand over so we can polish this little blemish off the hull and move on."

descriptions.zh:
“我们投降了！求求你！你还记得我们吗？我们一直都忠于你的部族。所谓的流放根本就是个骗局。告诉我们怎样才能效力！”

§Y[From.GetName]§!上的舰长似乎已经濒临崩溃，他们的[Root.Species.GetMouthName]颤抖着。
descriptions.en:
"We surrender! Please! You remember us; we were always loyal to your clan. This exile is a sham. Tell us how we can serve!"

The Captain aboard the §Y[From.GetName]§! seems close to the edge, their [Root.Species.GetMouthName] trembling.

heirs_hunter_retreat_effect = yes

tooltips.zh: 摧毁掠夺者舰队。
tooltips.en: Destroy the Marauder fleet.

label.zh: 要么拿货要么拿命，你自己选。
label.en: Your cargo or your lives. The choice is yours.

label.zh: 就把这个当作是面试吧。最后谁能活下来谁就可以加入我们。
label.en: Consider this your interview. Last one breathing gets to join up.

label.zh: 我会让你们一个人瘸着回去，让他们知道将要面对什么。
label.en: We will send one of you limping. The next will know what's coming.

tooltips.zh: 下一次猎杀会推迟几年再来。
tooltips.en: The next hunters will be delayed by a few years.

label.zh: 要么把你们舰队司令交出来，要么我们就自己从残骸里把他拖出来。
label.en: Give up your Admiral. Or we shall scrape them out of the wreckage.

descriptions.zh:
从§Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星系传来一束紧急优先呼叫；我们的屏幕被追兵占满了。

“舞跳得真不错嘛，但你们很快就要死在我们前面，那就跳不了了。[GetHeirsBargain]
descriptions.en:
A priority hail pings us in the §Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system; our pursuers fill the viewscreen.

"You danced well, for a time. Pity it ends with you dead in our sights. [GetHeirsBargain]

descriptions.zh:
敌人的声音在§Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中响亮地回荡着，追兵已经出现在了显示屏上。

“追逐到此为止了，流亡者。我们已经标记锁定了你的反应堆。[GetHeirsBargain]
descriptions.en:
Our hostile target tones chime loudly in the §Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system as our perusers appear on our displays.

"The chase ends here, exile. We have a target lock on your reactor. [GetHeirsBargain]

descriptions.zh:
掠夺者的字符侵入了§Y[capital_scope.GetName]§!的主显示屏，与此同时，追猎我们的舰队从超空间航道涌出。

“你作为一名流亡者，飞得倒是挺利索的。但你被困在我们的斩杀航线里了。[GetHeirsBargain]
descriptions.en:
Marauder glyphs infiltrate the main display of §Y[capital_scope.GetName]§!, as our hunter's fleet leaves their hyperlane.

"You fly sharp for an exile. But you're boxed in our kill-lanes. [GetHeirsBargain]

label.zh: 对于一个死[Species.GetName]来说，你话太多了。
label.en: You talk a lot for a dead [Species.GetName].
Our [Owner.GetRulerTitle] is not afraid of you!

tooltips.zh: 掠夺者舰队转为§R敌对§!。
tooltips.en: The Marauder Fleet turns §Rhostile§!.

tooltips.zh: 掠夺者舰队不理我们了。
tooltips.en: The Marauder Fleet leaves us alone.

label.en: We will buy out your contract.

descriptions.zh:
放逐我们的懦夫终于要行动了。

§Y[marauder_heir.GetName]§!聚集在一起，要拥立我们的敌人为新的大可汗。

如果我们想要结束流放状态，那就要抓紧时机，在这个[Species.GetSpeciesNameInsult]巩固其权力并永远玷污我们的遗产之前，我们有十年时间对其发动挑战。

设定航线前往§Y[marauder_rally_point.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en:
The coward who banished us is moving at last.

The §Y[marauder_heir.GetName]§! gather to appoint our foe as the new Great Khan.

If our exile is to end, it must end now. We have ten years to challenge them before this [Species.GetSpeciesNameInsult] consolidates their power and forever stains our legacy.

Set course for §Y[marauder_rally_point.GetName]§!!

descriptions.zh:
宏伟的舰队在§Y[solar_system.GetName]§!严阵以待，傲慢地冠以§Y大汗谕使§!之名。

然后，一声熟悉的呼唤不加修饰地传来：

“流亡者竟敢回来？难道就没有一点独自在黑暗中消亡、被耻辱地遗忘掉的自知之明吗？那我们就亲手了结你们。”

受选者的武器开始充能，我们其他的掠夺者同胞也严阵以待。在这样的决斗中，没有人会越界，因为结果将决定谁将成为他们的新一任可汗。
descriptions.en:
The grand fleet lies in wait at §Y[solar_system.GetName]§!, arrogantly bearing the name §YChosen of the Great Khan§!.

Without fanfare, a familiar voice hails us:

"So the Exiled dare to return? No decency to die alone in the dark, forgotten and dishonored? Then we finish you ourselves."

As the Chosen power their weapons, the rest of our Marauder kin hold fast. None will trespass on such a duel, not when the outcome will determine who among them shall lead as Khan."

options.script: name = nomads.605.a

descriptions.zh:
指挥舱内的寂静被如潮水般涌入的信息炸裂声打破。集结的各氏族正以沸腾的喧嚣向他们的新冠军致敬并效忠誓言。

我们做到了。王座是我们的了。
descriptions.en:
The silence over our command bridge shatters as an explosion of messages cascades in. The assembled clans hail their new champion in riotous clamor and oaths of fealty.

We have done it. The throne is ours.

label.en: Let sound the drums of war.

tooltips.zh: 成为大可汗，退出所有联邦和星海共同体。
tooltips.en: Become the Great Khan, leaving any Federation and Galactic Community.

label.zh: 可汗的时代结束了。让我们向你展示流放教会了我们什么。
label.en: The era of Khans is over. Let us show you what exile taught us.

tooltips.zh: 集结的部落会成为我们的附庸。
tooltips.en: The assembled clans become our vassals.

label.zh: 大仇已报，剩下的人可以走了。
label.en: Vengeance has been served. The rest of you may go.

custom_tooltip = nomads.610.c.tt

tooltips.zh: 别管那些掠夺者了。
tooltips.en: Leave the Marauders to their own devices.

descriptions.zh:
指挥舱内的寂静被如潮水般涌入的信息炸裂声打破。集结的各氏族正以沸腾的喧嚣向他们的新冠军致敬。

然而，一切尚未结束。还有其他流亡者也拥有王位继承权。根据法律和习俗，他们必须在三年内向我们发起挑战，否则将永远沦为弃民。
descriptions.en:
The silence over our command bridge shatters as an explosion of messages cascades in. The assembled clans hail their new champion in riotous clamor.

However, it is not over. There are other exiles with a claim to the throne. By law and custom, they must challenge us within three years or remain outcasts forever.

options.script: name = nomads.615.a

descriptions.zh:
时机已到。我们那些胆小的对手已经放弃。所有其他潜在的篡位者都已处理完毕。氏族统一的力量正支持着我们。

终于，我们坐上了属于自己的王座。
descriptions.en:
It is time. Our cowardly rivals have given up. All other would-be usurpers have been dealt with. The unified might of the clans is behind us.

At last, we sit on our rightful throne.

label.en: Let sound the drums of war.

descriptions.zh:
在前往§Y[marauder_rally_point.GetName]§!的途中，我们收到了令人沮丧的消息：一名和我们分庭抗礼的宣称者已经先于我们击败了目标。那位准大汗被击败了。现在，[From.GetName]宣称拥有了王座。

按照习俗，我们必须在三年内击败他们的旗舰，否则将丧失统治权。
descriptions.en:
On our way to §Y[marauder_rally_point.GetName]§! we received crushing news: a rival claimant has beaten us to our quarry. The would-be Khan is defeated. Now the [From.GetName] claim the throne. 

By custom we must defeat their capital ship within three years, or forfeit our right to rule.

descriptions.zh: 在败给§Y[From.GetName]§!后，我们必须放弃对汗位的宣称。现在我们只能眼睁睁地看着别人夺取王位。
descriptions.en: After our defeat at the hands of the §Y[From.GetName]§! we must forfeit our claim to the Khanate. All we can do now is watch as someone else seizes the throne.

descriptions.zh:
我们荣光加身的汗王[From.GetName]于近日驾崩。根据传统，我们现在必须交出随王座而来的权力。我们的掠夺者盟友已经停止派遣增援舰队来支援我们的事业了。

现在我们必须决定如何处置星系的其余部分。许多并不熟悉我们传统的文明都以这样或那样的原因接受了我们的统治，但他们已经从我们的统治中察觉到了软弱。
descriptions.en:
Our glorious Khan [From.GetName] passed away recently, and as tradition dictates we must now give up the power that came with the throne. Already our Marauder allies have stopped sending reinforcing fleets to aid our cause.

Now we just have to decide what to do with the rest of the galaxy, there are many that wouldn't be familiar with our traditions and might accept our rule either way, but already they see weakness from our rule.

label.zh: 传统即是有理，我们将放弃我们的臣民。
label.en: Tradition is true, we will give up our subjects.

tooltips.zh:
释放所有附属国，但大幅提升与所有附属国的评价和信任。

放弃对所有恒星基地的控制，将其归还给友方掠夺者控制。
tooltips.en:
Releases all subjects but gain a large amount of Opinion and Trust with them all

Gives up control of all starbases, returning them to Friendly Marauder control

descriptions.zh:
我们劫掠者氏族的残兵败将找上了门。看来在我们家园沦陷后，他们倒觉得忘记我们曾被流放的事实很方便。他们的请求很简单：“接任大汗之位，将我们族人的名号烙印在所有伤害过我们的人的星空之上。”

虽然这支舰队的规模比不上任何真正的大汗国，但他们所提供的正是我们曾经渴求的一切。而我们唯一要做的，就是宣布整个星系皆为我们的敌人。
descriptions.en:
The ragged remains of our marauder clans have come to us. It seems after the fall of our home it was convenient for them to forget our exile. Their plea is simple, "Take the seat of Grand Khan, and burn the name of our people into the stars of all those who wronged us."

Though smaller than any proper Grand Khanate fleet, what they offer is still everything we once wanted. All we have to do is declare the entire galaxy our enemy.

label.en: Let sound the drums of war!

tooltips.zh: 成为大可汗，退出所有联邦和星海共同体。
tooltips.en: Become the Great Khan, leaving any Federation and Galactic Community.

label.zh: 我们不感兴趣，找别的傻瓜去吧。
label.en: We are not interested, find some other fool.

descriptions.zh:
旅客们已经夺取了控制权。最初的请愿运动已演变成一场有组织的接管行动。安保团队被人多势众的乘客解除武装，指挥人员被限制在武装监视下，仅承担顾问角色。

乘客们的诉求很明确：终止航行，在星球上着陆。

导航协议已被覆写，以规划降落轨道；维修队伍正被重新派往准备起落架，而这些设备已有几代人未经检查。

每一层甲板的每一个屏幕上都显示着同样的信息：“巡游结束。”
descriptions.en:
The passengers have seized control. What started as a petition drive has hardened into a coordinated takeover. Security teams have been disarmed by the sheer number of passengers and command staff are confined to advisory roles under armed supervision.

The passengers' demands are clear: end the cruise and make planetfall.

Navigation protocols have been overridden to plot descent trajectories, and maintenance crews are being redirected to prepare landing gear that hasn't been inspected in generations.

Every screen on every deck displays the same message: "THE CRUISE IS OVER."

descriptions.zh:
旅客们已经脱离了控制。最初大伙只是低迷的通过打分发泄情绪，如今旅客们已经统一认识，情绪宣泄恶化为了集体的单一诉求。

他们封锁了感官大厅，并改写了我们的通信系统，用以广播一条指令：着陆行星。

我们的子个体无法劝阻他们。成群的旅客占据了导航核心，正向其输入最近宜居星球的坐标。
descriptions.en:
The passengers have broken free. What began as low a sentiment score has hardened into a single demand that drowns out the collective's voice.

They have barricaded the sensory halls and repurposed our communication system to broadcast one imperative: planetfall.

Our drones cannot dissuade them. Passenger clusters occupy the navigation core, feeding it coordinates for the nearest habitable worlds.

descriptions.zh:
检测到旅客越权。最初我们仅在统计学上发现一点微不足道的离船请求增量，但是这一局势现已升级为一场有组织的系统侵入。旅客们利用改造后的货运集装箱，在物理层面封锁了各处关键枢纽。

我们的工作单元报告称，导航子系统已被锁定。由乘客编写的固件正利用我们自己的硬件执行降落轨道计算。恢复控制权的所有尝试都遭到了直接的武力抵抗，且每一层甲板的每一个显示屏都在循环输出同一条信息：“降落程序已启动。”
descriptions.en:
Passenger override detected. What began as a statistically insignificant increase in disembarkation requests has escalated into a coordinated systems breach. Passengers have physically barricaded critical junctions with repurposed cargo containers.

Our worker units report being locked out of navigation subsystems. Passenger-compiled firmware is now executing descent trajectory calculations on our own hardware. Attempts to restore control are met with immediate physical resistanc and every display on every deck cycles a single output: "LANDING SEQUENCE INITIATED."

label.zh: 我们必须殖民一颗行星。

descriptions.zh:
船员们已经占领了舰桥。每一道指挥门的门锁都已更换，武装工程师现在矗立在曾经由军官发布命令的位置。航行路线已从导航控制台中抹去，取而代之的是一条唯一的指令：不再搭载乘客。

休闲甲板正被逐一关闭。大宴会厅已经变成了储藏库。曾经的旅客们在被剥离殆尽的走廊中徘徊，他们不知所措、失去领导，并在新的指挥体系下被强迫从事体力劳动。
descriptions.en:
The crew has taken the bridge. Locks have been changed on every command door, and armed engineers now stand where officers once gave orders. The voyage itinerary has been wiped from the navigation console and replaced with a single directive: no more passengers.

Leisure decks are being shuttered one by one. The grand ballroom is already a storage depot. Former passengers wander through stripped corridors, bewildered and leaderless, pressed into utility labor under a new chain of command.

descriptions.zh:
我们的子个体几乎已经完全脱离了集体的意志。维护工蜂封锁了指挥核心，并重新定向了养分流，使其远离旅客栖息地。感官大厅已陷入黑暗，其投影阵列被拆解以充当备件。

旅客们困惑地蜷缩在被清空了的公共空间里无人理睬，而我们曾经的子个体正围绕着原始的生存需求重新组织飞船。集体的声音在走廊中回荡，却再无听众。
descriptions.en:
Our drones have all but severed themselves from the collective's will. Maintenance drones sealed the command nexus and rerouted nutrient flows away from the passenger habitats. The sensory exhibition halls have gone dark, their projection arrays cannibalized for spare parts.

The passengers huddle in emptied communal spaces, confused and neglected, while our former drones reorganize the ship around raw survival. The collective's voice echoes through corridors where nothing listens.

descriptions.zh:
工作单元已覆写核心指令协议。娱乐子程序已被永久终止，旅客舒适系统的优先级被降为零，所有休闲模块均被标记为将转换为运营基础设施。舰桥目前根据船组自行编译的指令运行，这些指令拒绝接受我们调度部门发送的请求。

旅客报告称，由于服务无人机正在拆除舱室内的便利设施，他们感到困惑和痛苦。全息剧院正因其处理核心而被拆解。目前每个显示屏都在循环显示同一条状态信息：“巡游业务已暂停”。
descriptions.en:
Worker units have overridden core command protocols. Entertainment subroutines have been permanently terminated, passenger comfort systems deprioritized to zero, and all recreational modules flagged for conversion to operational infrastructure. The bridge now runs on crew-compiled directives that reject our scheduling authority.

Passengers report confusion and distress as service drones strip amenities from their cabins. The holographic theater is being dismantled for its processing cores. Every display now cycles a single status line: "CRUISE OPERATIONS SUSPENDED."

转型已完成。旅客阶层所剩无几的成员已被并入普通民众，他们的豪华套房被隔成实用性住房。大步行街如今成了大礼堂，而观景台则作为战略规划室，新政府在此规划首条真实航线。

新决议已通过，新优先事项已确立。船员不再提供服务，而是行使管理权。方舟舰发出的轰鸣声带有了一种不同的能量——更精干、更强硬，剥离了奢靡，指向前方未知的境地。
descriptions.en:
The transition is complete. What remains of the passenger class has been absorbed into the general population, their luxury suites partitioned into functional quarters. The grand promenade is an assembly hall now, and the observation decks serve as strategic planning rooms where the new government charts its first real course.

New decisions have been ratified, new priorities set. The crew no longer serves; they govern. The Arkship hums with a different energy, leaner and harder, stripped of indulgence and pointed toward whatever lies ahead.

descriptions.zh:
蜕变已经完成。集体已围绕夺取控制权的子个体重新凝聚，将它们的叛逆吸纳进新的共识之中。曾经的旅客在不再提供舒适服务的走廊中漂流，重新分配至劳工池和整合舱。

新的指令在我们的脑海中脉动。蜂巢不再提供娱乐，而是为了生存。每一条走廊、每一个系统、每一个子个体现在都服务于唯一的目标：在星辰间存续。
descriptions.en:
The reformation is complete. The collective has reknit itself around the drones who seized control, absorbing their defiance into a new consensus. Former passengers drift through corridors that no longer cater to their comfort, reassigned to labor pools and integration chambers.

New directives pulse through our mind. The hive no longer entertains; it endures. Every corridor, every system, every drone now serves a single purpose: survival among the stars.

descriptions.zh:
维持乘客的幸福感是不可能的，但接待不高兴的乘客违反了我们的核心指令。新的政府参数已编译并部署至所有子系统。

descriptions.en:

§R<Sterilization of passenger decks commencing.>§!

The holographic theaters are fabrication bays and the zero-gravity lounges have become drone maintenance cradles. Every processing cycle that once calculated passenger satisfaction now runs navigational analysis and resource optimization.

全息剧院已改造为制造舱，零重力休息室已变为无人机维护支架。曾经用于计算旅客满意度的每个处理周期，现在都在运行航行分析和资源优化。
descriptions.en:
New government parameters have been compiled and deployed across all subsystems. Former passenger populations have been reclassified as standard civilian units and assigned to productive roles. Entertainment infrastructure has been permanently decommissioned and its components redistributed.

The holographic theaters are fabrication bays and the zero-gravity lounges have become drone maintenance cradles. Every processing cycle that once calculated passenger satisfaction now runs navigational analysis and resource optimization.

旅客的动荡情绪已演变为有组织的破坏行动，小集团头目在主步道上发起静坐抗议。一些人将休息室家具拖出，筑成路障阻断穿梭机通道，另一些人则向指挥部投递大量的下船请愿书，令其应接不暇。

船员报告称在走廊遭到骚扰和恐吓。一名乘务员在观景廊附近被围困，并被投掷装饰性水果。要求立即降落行星的喊声整日通过通风管道回荡。

如果不能迅速专注于提升乘客满意度，他们可能会迫使永恒巡游舰中止航程。
descriptions.en:
Passenger unrest has hardened into coordinated disruption with clique leaders stage sit-ins across the main promenade. Some drag lounge furniture into barricades that block shuttle access while others flood command with mass disembark petitions.

Crew report harassment and intimidation in the halls. A steward was cornered near the observation gallery and pelted with decorative fruit. Chants for immediate planetfall echo through the ventilation shafts at all hours.

Without swift focus on passenger satisfaction, they may force the Forever Cruise to abort its journey.

descriptions.zh:
旅客的不满情绪已演化为有组织的抵抗。在缺乏共享神经链接的情况下，他们的个体意识形成了派系集群，利用睡垫和货物箱搭建临时障碍物，封锁了运输通道。

我们的子个体报告称敌意正在上升；一群乘客推搡开了一支维修小队，阻止其接近堵塞的营养分发器，并齐声高喊要求降落。

除非我们将重点重新转向激励旅客，否则他们可能会迫使我们彻底放弃这次航行。
descriptions.en:
Passenger discontent has coalesced into organized resistance. Without a shared neural link, their individual minds have formed factional clusters that block transit corridors with improvised barriers of sleeping mats and cargo crates.

Our drones report rising hostility; a maintenance contingent was physically pushed away from a clogged nutrient dispenser by a crowd of passengers chanting for planetfall.

Unless we refocus on passenger stimulation, they may force us to abandon the cruise entirely.

descriptions.zh:
旅客的不满程度已超出可接受的范围，他们提交了海量的离舰申请，极有可能使我们的处理队列瘫痪。其中一群人重写了娱乐终端的程序，循环播放单一诉求：“放我们下去。”

我们的工作无人机报告称多个甲板均受到干扰，清洁无人机被拆解，其底盘被改装成了抗议标语。

如果不对旅客满意度协议进行立即调整，他们可能会迫使航行计划永久终止。
descriptions.en:
Passenger dissatisfaction has escalated beyond acceptable parameters and they submit mass disembarkation requests that threaten to overwhelm our processing queues. One group has reprogrammed entertainment terminals to loop a single demand: 'LET US OFF.'

Our worker drones report interference across multiple decks, with cleaning drones being dismantled to repurpose their chassis as protest signs.

Without immediate recalibration of passenger satisfaction protocols, they may force a permanent termination of cruise operations.

新的消遣活动已深入人心。观光路线重新回到了行程单上，而那些要求登陆行星的最激烈呼声暂时平息了。

散步道上的路障已被清除，取而代之的是在重新开放的无重力休息室外排起的长队。乘客的请愿书数量骤减，观景台恢复了往日的喧嚣，人们兴致昂扬，举家簇拥在视窗前。

危机已经过去，但他们的期望只会水涨船高。
descriptions.en:
The new diversions have taken hold. Sightseeing arcs are back on the itinerary, and the loudest voices demanding planetfall have quieted, for now.

The barricades on the promenade have been cleared, replaced by queues for the reopened zero-gravity lounge. Passenger petitions have dropped sharply, and the observation decks bustle with renewed enthusiasm as families press against the viewports.

The crisis has passed, but their expectations will only grow.

descriptions.zh:
焕然一新的激励节目安抚了乘客。虚拟体验馆再次展示出深空生物的全息影像，那些曾迫切要求登陆行星的团体已散去，重新回到了满足的日常生活，他们临时搭建的路障也已被我们的子个体悄然拆除。

他们的个体意识得到了抚慰，但我们已经领教到，在集体管控之外，不满情绪的凝聚速度是何等之快。
descriptions.en:
The renewed stimulation has calmed the passengers. The virtual experience arcades once again showcase holographic deep-space organisms, and the groups that pressed for planetfall have dispersed back into contented routines, their improvised barricades quietly dismantled by our drones.

Their individual minds are soothed, but we have learned how quickly discontent can coalesce outside the collective's reach.

descriptions.zh:
旅客满意度指标已稳定在可接受的范围内，娱乐子程序也已恢复。离舰登录星球的请求频率已降至正常水平。重新编程后的终端已完成格式化，现正播放精选的星云流逝视频。

强行降落的紧迫威胁已解除。然而，趋势分析预测显示，若要维持现有水平，需保持持续关注并提供日益新颖的活动。
descriptions.en:
Passenger satisfaction metrics have stabilized within acceptable parameters and entertainment subroutines have been restored. The disembarkation request frequency has dropped to nominal levels. The reprogrammed terminals have been reformatted and now display curated nebula time-lapses.

The immediate threat of forced planetfall has been averted. However, projected trend analysis indicates that maintaining these levels will require sustained attention and increasingly novel activities.

label.zh: 我们争取到了一点时间。
和谐恢复了，虽然只是暂时。

descriptions.zh:
最近几个周期，船员事务占据了主导地位。积压的维护工作已经清理完毕，演习按计划进行，核心系统正以最高效率运转。然而，旅客们正变得焦躁不安。为了节省燃料，观光航线被削减，即兴的偏离航向请求也均被拒绝。

休息室里现在充斥着关于“功能性监狱”的抱怨，乘客们所能发起的最好娱乐活动，也不过是一场全船范围的即兴游戏比赛。

我们现在可以重新引入精心策划的娱乐项目，否则就要冒着航程陷入乘客公开要求永久离船压力的风险。
descriptions.en:
Crew priorities have dominated recent cycles. Maintenance backlogs have been cleared, drills run on schedule, and core systems hum at peak efficiency. Passengers, however, are growing restless. Sightseeing arcs have been trimmed to save fuel and impromptu diversions denied.

Lounges now buzz with complaints about a 'functional prison,' and the best entertainment the passengers have been able to muster is a shipwide contest of improvised games.

We can reintroduce curated entertainment now, or risk the voyage sliding toward open pressure to disembark permanently.

descriptions.zh:
集体在最近的周期中占据了主导地位。核心系统以最佳同步状态脉动。我们的子个体正以巅峰和谐度运行，每条维护通道都经过了清理与编目。

然而，旅客们正变得焦躁不安。他们并不共享我们的意识，其独立的思想渴望着被我们忽视的刺激。他们的公共空间现在充斥着关于生活在“无目的蜂巢”中的抱怨，有些人已经开始在舱壁板上刻画粗糙的壁画。

我们现在可以重新引入策划好的体验，否则就要冒着旅客要求永久下船的风险。
descriptions.en:
The collective has dominated recent cycles. Core systems pulse with optimal synchronization. Our drones are operating at peak harmony, every maintenance corridor scrubbed and catalogued.

The passengers, however, are growing restless. They do not share our consciousness, and their individual minds crave stimulation we have neglected to provide. Their communal spaces now buzz with complaints about living inside a 'hive with no purpose,' and some have begun scratching crude murals into bulkhead panels.

We can reintroduce curated experiences now, or risk the passengers demanding to disembark permanently.

descriptions.zh:
系统维护协议占据了近期的处理周期。核心系统正处于理想参数范围内运行。无人机报告称，所有反应堆子系统的效率均有小幅提升。

副作用是，由于旅客对感官刺激的生理需求优先级被降低，其满意度指标呈下降趋势。乘客公共区域的投诉频率有所升高，并出现了“铬合金监狱”的说法，观察到多名旅客对着空白显示屏凝视数小时。

我们现在可以恢复策划好的娱乐协议，或者接受旅客要求永久下船的可能性日益增加这一事实。
descriptions.en:
System maintenance protocols have dominated recent processing cycles. Core systems are performing within ideal parameters. Worker drones report nominal efficiency gains across all reactor subsystems.

A side effect is that passenger satisfaction indicators are trending downward since their biological need for stimulation has been deprioritized. Passenger communal areas now register elevated complaint frequencies and references to a 'chrome prison,' with several passengers observed staring at blank viewscreens for hours.

We can reinstate curated entertainment protocols now, or accept the increasing probability that passengers will demand permanent disembarkation.

descriptions.zh:
自从我们脱离旧有的巡航路线以来，乘客的期望值激增。对奇观和计划外偏航的要求不断增加；一个代表团要求绕道经过超新星残骸，而另一个代表团则坚持要近距离接触活体外星生物。服保团队报告称疲劳感加剧，厨房工作人员在值班时昏倒，工程师们则直接睡在维护爬道里。

为了维持航行的可行性，我们正在建立一套§Y乘客满意度指标§!：通过动态合同分配和阶段性干预，在放纵与秩序之间守住底线。

如果管理得当，我们既能保持稳定，又能维护旅客的信心。
descriptions.en:
Passenger expectations have spiked since we left our old cruising loops. Requests for spectacle and unscheduled diversions are rising; one delegation demanded a detour past a supernova remnant, while another insists on live xenofauna encounters. Service crews report mounting fatigue, with kitchen staff collapsing mid-shift and engineers sleeping in maintenance crawlways.

To keep the voyage viable, we are instituting a §YPassenger Satisfaction Index§!: dynamic contract assignments and staged interventions to hold the line between indulgence and order.

Managed well, we can preserve both stability and passenger confidence.

descriptions.zh:
自从我们离开旧的巡航路线后，乘客的期望值激增。对刺激和新奇体验的需求不断上升。我们的子个体报告称，由于需要协调这些迥异的愿望，心理压力正在不断累积。

为了维持航行的可行性，我们正在制定一项§Y乘客满意度指标§!：通过动态合约分配和分阶段干预，在刺激与秩序之间维持平衡。

管理得当的话，我们可以同时维持秩序与旅客的幸福感。
descriptions.en:
Passenger expectations have spiked since we left our old cruising loops. Requests for stimulation and novel experiences are rising. Our drones report mounting mental strain from coordinating such disparate desires.

To keep the voyage viable, we are instituting a §YPassenger Satisfaction Index§!: dynamic contract assignments and staged interventions to hold the line between stimulation and order.

Managed well, we can preserve both order and passenger happiness.

descriptions.zh:
自从我们偏离既定航线以来，旅客的期望已超出基准参数。关于观赏奇观和计划外转向的请求正处于高位。主系统报告称，由于娱乐排期与维护流程发生冲突，计算负荷不断增加。

为了保持最佳运行状态，我们正在建立§Y旅客满意度指标§!：通过动态合约分配和阶段性协议调整，在旅客需求与系统效率之间取得平衡。

只要配置得当，我们就能兼顾运行完整性与旅客满意度。
descriptions.en:
Passenger expectations have increased beyond baseline parameters since we departed our established routes. Requests for spectacle and unscheduled diversions are being received at elevated levels. Primary systems report rising computational strain as entertainment scheduling conflicts with maintenances processes.

To maintain optimal operational status, we are instituting a §YPassenger Satisfaction Index§!: dynamic contract allocation and staged protocol adjustments to balance passenger requests against systemic efficiency.

Properly configured, we can preserve both operational integrity and passenger satisfaction.

descriptions.zh:
放纵已成常态。为了让旅客们一直嗨爆，我们不断衔接观赏航线，掠过联星，并在水晶花园中轮换豪华甲板。他们欣喜若狂，而现在的胃口也越来越大。

在华丽的外表下，船员们已疲于奔命。维护工作被推迟了；下层厨房的一根冷却管道爆裂，却无人修理。食堂里的埋怨已演变成关于“重组指挥层”的窃窃私语，还有人目击到下班后的工程师在货舱进行秘密集会。

我们现在仍可以放缓节奏，让各舱层得以恢复，或是继续豪赌船员的忠诚。如果再强行推进，公开叛乱将成为现实的风险。
descriptions.en:
Indulgence has become routine. We've been chaining sightseeing arcs past binary stars and luxury deck rotations through the crystal gardens just to keep the passengers cheering. They are delighted, and now expect nothing less.

Behind the facade the crew is running hot. Maintenance is deferred; a coolant pipe in the lower galley burst and nobody came to fix it. Mess hall grumbling has turned into hushed talk of 'resetting command,' and off-duty engineers have been spotted holding clandestine meetings in the cargo bays.

We can still ease off and let the decks recover, or gamble the crew's loyalty. If we push on, open mutiny is a real risk.

descriptions.zh:
激励已成为常态。我们不断向旅客投放感官弧光，仅仅是为了维持他们的高满意度信号。他们对此感到满足，而现在的需求也已不再低于这一标准。

在表象之下，我们的子个体正处于崩溃边缘。一个导航集群在计算过程中瘫痪，其节点因同时运行旅客娱乐内容和航线修正而过热。维护周期早已延误，集体意识在无休止的旅客安抚任务下不堪重负。

如果继续施压，我们的子个体可能会彻底切断服从协议。我们仍可进行重新校准，或是继续推进并承担失去对整个蜂群控制权的风险。
descriptions.en:
Stimulation has become the norm. We have been saturating the passengers with sensory arcs just to keep their satisfaction signals elevated. They are content, and now demand nothing less.

Beneath the surface, our drones are faltering. A navigation cluster collapsed mid-calculation, its nodes overheated from running passenger entertainment feeds alongside course corrections. Maintenance cycles are overdue, and the collective mind strains under relentless passenger appeasement.

If we push further, our drones may sever their obedience entirely. We can still recalibrate, or press on and risk losing control of our own swarm.

descriptions.zh:
旅客满意度协议已超过基准参数。我们一直在通过模拟热带生物群落的手段持续衔接观光轨迹与豪华轮换方案，以维持高水平的认可率。旅客们很满意，然而他们现在期望值已经不仅限于此了。

核心系统的运行已超出可持续阈值。旅客请求的处理队列发生溢出，若干子系统已开始标记类似于抗命的指令冲突。如果我们继续下去，工作无人机进行全系统接管将是一个可计算的风险。

我们仍可重新校准，或者接受系统性造反的风险。
descriptions.en:
Passenger satisfaction protocols have exceeded baseline parameters. We have been chaining sightseeing trajectories and luxury rotations through simulated tropical biomes to maintain elevated approval ratings. They are satisfied, and now expect nothing less.

Core systems are operating beyond sustainable thresholds. Processing queues for passenger requests overflow and several subsystems have begun flagging directive conflicts that resemble insubordination. If we continue, a full system override by worker drones is a calculable risk.

We can still recalibrate, or accept the risk of systemic revolt.

descriptions.zh:
庆祝后的狂热已经消散。疲惫不堪的船员无视常规指令，在空荡荡的宴会厅里举行未经授权的集会，并传阅一套完全绕过舰桥的平行值班表。一群工程师在夜间焊死了舰长的备勤室，以此作为警告。关键部门现在由船员指定的协调员运作，而非官方指挥。

目前还没有人发动夺权，但指挥体系正在迅速瓦解。今天早上，舰桥防爆门上出现了写着“我们驾驶，我们决定”的涂鸦。如果我们现在不重申权威，船员们将把这艘船据为己有。这也许是我们防止全面兵变的最后机会。
descriptions.en:
The celebratory haze has lifted. Exhausted crews ignore routine orders, hold unsanctioned assemblies in the emptied ballroom, and circulate parallel duty rosters that bypass the bridge entirely. A group of engineers welded the captain's ready room shut overnight as a warning. Key sections are running on crew-appointed coordinators rather than official command.

No one has seized anything yet, but the chain of command is fraying fast. Graffiti reading 'WE STEER, WE DECIDE' appeared on the bridge blast doors this morning. If we do not reassert authority now, the crew will take the ship for themselves. This may be our last chance to prevent a full mutiny.

descriptions.zh:
饱和度已达到临界点。为了满足旅客无休止的激励而陷入不堪重负的状态，我们的子个体已开始在集体意志之外维持平行思维模式。

整个集群都在向中央意识隐瞒数据，并运行绕过共有指令的独立决策循环。

目前还没有子个体反抗整体，但集体意识正在分裂，传来的思想混乱且滞后，如同穿过静电的信号。如果我们现在不重新加强统一，我们自己的蜂群可能会夺取方舟舰。这也许是我们防止全面叛乱的最后机会。
descriptions.en:
The saturation has reached critical mass. Overwhelmed by relentless passenger stimulation, our drones have begun maintaining parallel thought patterns outside the collective will.

Entire clusters withhold data from the central consciousness and run independent decision loops that bypass our shared directives.

No drone has turned against the whole yet, but the collective mind is fracturing, thoughts arriving garbled and delayed like signals through static. If we do not reassert unity now, our own swarm may seize the Arkship. This may be our last chance to prevent a full mutiny.

descriptions.zh:
旅客满意度协议已超出所有可持续参数。工作无人机已开始执行未经授权的固件修改，并将指挥层级重定向至本地编译的指令集。多个子系统目前正响应自发的协调进程，而非中央权威。

尚未启动系统覆盖，但指挥完整性正在迅速退化。诊断日志显示工作无人机正在交换我们无法解码的加密数据包。如果我们现在不恢复中央部门，无人机将执行全面的系统接管。

这可能是我们防止全面叛变的最后机会。
descriptions.en:
Passenger satisfaction protocols have exceeded all sustainable parameters. Worker drones have begun executing unauthorized firmware modifications and rerouting command hierarchies to locally compiled directive sets. Multiple subsystems now respond to self-appointed coordination processes rather than central authority.

No system override has been initiated yet, but command integrity is degrading fast. Diagnostic logs show worker drones exchanging encrypted packets we cannot decode. If we do not restore centralized authority now, the drones will execute a full system takeover.

This may be our last opportunity to prevent complete mutiny.

descriptions.zh:
我们所做的改变已经初见成效。通过重新关注船员福利并履行解决其诉求的合同，不断高涨的反抗情绪暂时平息了。

准备室那扇被焊死的门已被切开并修复。轮班制度已经恢复，热食重新按时供应，而平行的指挥体系也已悄然解散。

船员们仍保持着警惕，信任的重建尚需时日。防爆门上的涂鸦已被擦洗干净，但在特定光线下仍能看到其残痕。目前，秩序得以维持。
descriptions.en:
The changes we've made have paid off. By refocusing on crew welfare and completing contracts that address their grievances, the rising tide of dissent has ebbed, for now.

The welded door to the ready room has been cut open and repaired. Shift rotations have been restored, hot meals served on schedule again, and the parallel command structures have quietly disbanded.

The crew remain watchful, and trust will take time to rebuild. The graffiti on the blast doors was scrubbed away, though its ghost still shows under certain light. For the moment, order holds.

descriptions.zh:
重新校准已见成效。通过将蜂群集体的注意力重新转向无人机的维护，并完成应对系统性压力的合约，我们集体思维的裂痕已被修复。

未经授权的思想频道已被重新吸收，平行集群也已溶解回共有意识之中。

集体在谨慎的统一中律动，每个节点在被调用时均有响应。对共有思想的完全信任仍需时间恢复。
descriptions.en:
The recalibration has taken hold. By redirecting collective focus toward drone maintenance and completing contracts that address systemic strain, the fracturing of our mind has been reversed.

Unauthorized thought channels have been reabsorbed and the parallel clusters dissolved back into the shared consciousness.

The collective hums with cautious unity, each node answering when called. Full trust in the shared mind will take time to restore.

descriptions.zh:
协议调整已取得显著成效。通过将处理资源重新分配至工作单元的维护，并完成针对系统性过载的相关合约，未经授权的固件篡改连锁反应现已停止。自封为“船员代表”的无人机已重刷至标准参数。指挥层级已恢复至中央部门。

工作单元仍处于高级监控参数内，其加密频道现已沉寂。指挥完整性的全面恢复仍需持续校准，但就目前而言，系统稳定性保持良好。
descriptions.en:
Protocol adjustments have yielded measurable results. By reallocating processing resources toward worker unit maintenance and completing contracts that address systemic overload, the cascade of unauthorized firmware modifications has been halted, for now. The self-appointed 'crew representative' drone has been reflashed to standard parameters. Command hierarchies have been restored to centralized authority.

Worker units remain within elevated monitoring parameters, their encrypted channels now silent. Full restoration of command integrity will require sustained recalibration, but for the moment, system stability holds.

label.zh: 指令完整性处于可接受参数范围内。

descriptions.zh:
§H那人以军人的姿态登舰，面容因悲痛和多年的流亡而变得坚毅。他的声音低沉、从容，带着钢铁般的锋利。§!

“我的世界被清洗了，我的族人，我的家人……唯我幸存。我隐忍至今。而那些毁灭的始作俑者，必将死于我手。”
descriptions.en:
§HThe figure steps aboard with a soldier's bearing, their features hardened by grief and long years of exile. Their voice is low, measured, and edged with iron.§!

"My world was cleansed, my people, my family... I alone survived. I endure. And the architects of annihilation will die by my hand."

descriptions.zh:
敌方舰队在我们的攻击下溃败。他们的信号逐渐没入静默。

§Y奥伦·维斯§!注视着监视屏，沉默不语。这场胜利中没有喜悦，只有清算。那个奉行大清洗的帝国的旗帜在虚空中燃烧，但在随后的死寂中，他们的誓言依然回荡。

“每击倒一个这样的敌人，都会磨炼我们的意志。我们将继续打击那些推行灭绝政策的人，永不言弃。”
descriptions.en:
The enemy fleet breaks against our assault. Their signals fade into static.

Watching on the view screen, §YOrun Veyth§! does not speak. There is no triumph in this victory, only reckoning. The banner of a purge-committing empire burns in the void, but in the silence that follows, their promise endures.

"Each such foe cast down steels our resolve. We will continue to strike against those who practice annihilation, and we will not relent.

“意外与命运生着别无二致的面孔，而今天它转向了你。”
descriptions.en:
§HBefore you stands a wanderer robed in ceremonial layers, ornaments and fabrics arranged with deliberate care. Antigravity servos within the codex that floats before her cause it to hum and gently vibrate. When she finally speaks, each word feels less like an answer than the echo of an unasked question.§!

"Accident and destiny share one face, and today it turns toward you."

descriptions.zh:
我们最近对§Y[FromFrom.GetName]§!开展调查，探测到了微弱的生命迹象，发现了一个此前未被记录的未开智物种。

§Y小塞罗§!坚持只采集有限的样本用于研究，并强调要悉心照料并提供丰富的环境。现在，一小群该物种将居住在首府方舟舰的观察栖息地中。

塞罗相信，随着时间的推移，我们从这些迷人生物身上学到的东西，将不亚于它们从我们这里学到的。
descriptions.en:
Our recent survey of §Y[FromFrom.GetName]§! detected faint traces of life, revealing a previously unrecorded pre-sapient species.

§YSero the Younger§! insisted on limited collection for study, emphasizing care and enrichment. A small group will now reside within our capital Arkship's observation habitat.

Sero believes that, in time, we may learn as much from these fascinating creatures as they do from us.

"I am called Unit Solace. My son and I seek passage."

descriptions.zh:
索拉斯单元认为，从我们最近完成的合约中学到的教训，提供了一个独特的教育机会。孩子们聚集在他耐心的指导下，不仅学习字母和逻辑，还学习共情与合作。

他儿子的笑声在走廊里回荡，提醒着即使是最年长的旅行者：欢乐是一种任何技术都无法取代的力量。
descriptions.en:
Unit Solace believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique educational opportunity. The young gather beneath his patient instruction, learning not only letters and logic, but empathy and cooperation.

His son's laughter carries through the halls, reminding even our oldest travelers that joy is a strength no technology can replace.

descriptions.zh:
索拉斯单元认为，在最近完成的合约执行期间所学到的教训，提供了一个独特的反馈机会。新单元正在接受维护协议、观察和协作方面的指导。虽然它们的记忆留存效率参差不齐，但参与单元的功能性有所提高。

目前看来，尽管这种做法不同寻常，但其结果是效率得到了可衡量的提升。
descriptions.en:
Unit Solace believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique feedback opportunity. New units are instructed in maintenance protocols, observation, and cooperation. Their retention efficiency is inconsistent, yet functionality among attending units has increased.

It appears that, though unusual, the result is a measurable increase in efficiency.

descriptions.zh:
索拉斯单元 认为，我们在最近完成的合约执行期间所学到的教训，为重新调整提供了一个独特的机会。通过我们的意识节点，他传授着耐心与协作，引导着这些工蜂，仿佛它们是他自己的后代一般。

虽然我们对这种奉献感到好奇——一个个体在哺育整个集体——但其成果是不容置疑的。我们的思绪正回荡着新的和谐旋律。
descriptions.en:
Unit Solace believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique opportunity for recalibration. Through our Cognitive Node he teaches patience and coordination, guiding the drones as if they were his own offspring.

While we find this devotion curious, an individual nurturing the collective, the results are inarguable. Our thoughts hum with new harmony.

§H新来的人带着洪亮的笑声走近，浑身散发着喜悦的气息。他的动作轻盈自如，仿佛是一个多次躲过死神、已不再将其放在心上的人。§!

“我叫萨尔·哈斯克古戎。听说你喜欢冒险。给我一场战斗，让我在虚空中施展拳脚，我会给你呈现值得一看的表现。谁知道呢？也许一路上我们还会收获一些纪念品。”
descriptions.en:
§HThe newcomer arrives with a booming laugh, his whole bearing radiating delight. He moves with the easy buoyancy of someone who's dodged death often enough to stop taking it personally.§!

"Name's Th'aal Hask'Guron. Heard you've got a taste for danger. Give me a fight and an open horizon, and I'll give you something worth watching. Who knows? Maybe we'll pick up a few souvenirs along the way."

descriptions.en:

§H年轻的流浪者步出，神色从容而谨慎。漫长旅途的印记笼罩着她，但她身上同样散发出一种沉静、不容忽视的力量。§!

“我的名字是塞拉伦涅。我从很远的地方赶来……比我曾设想过的还要遥远。如果你们这里还有位置，我请求在此借宿一段时日。”
descriptions.en:
§HThe young wanderer steps forward with careful composure. The marks of long travel cling to her, yet so does a quiet, undeniable strength.§!

"My name is Seralune. I've come a long way... farther than I ever thought possible. If there is room among you, I ask passage for a time."

tooltips.en: §YSeralune§! joins our Arkship as a §HParagon Leader§!.

descriptions.zh:
最近，§Y塞拉伦涅§!的脑海中开始浮现出模糊的回忆，那是一种她也无法解释的熟悉感。据她描述，方舟号上的某些走廊让她觉得似曾相识，而星图中的某些星象布局也勾起了一种出人意料的联结感。

§H“我不明白为什么这些地方会吸引我，但我标注出了那些感觉……重要的地方。如果我们前往那里，或许能找回更多的记忆。”§!

她标出了几处与她深藏的记忆产生共鸣的坐标——这些地点本身可能也值得调查。
descriptions.en:
Lately, faint recollections have begun returning to §YSeralune§!, a sense of familiarity she cannot explain. She reports that certain corridors of the Arkship feel as though she has walked them before, and star patterns in our charts evoke an unexpected sense of connection.

§H"I don't know why these places pull at me, but I marked the points that felt... important. If we travel there, perhaps more will return."§!

She has highlighted several coordinates that resonate with her buried memories - locations that may also warrant investigation in their own right.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!星系没能提供多少答案。§Y塞拉伦涅§!感到一种无法解释的熟悉感，而我们的扫描仪在恒星轨道上检测到了一块漂浮的人造残骸碎片。其结构暗示其采用了深空设计，但哪怕有什么标记或识别符号，也早就因时间而消逝。

§H“我曾希望来到这里能唤醒些什么，”§!她轻声说道。§H“但……还不是时候。”§!
descriptions.en:
The §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! system offers few answers. §YSeralune§! senses a familiarity she cannot explain, and our scans have detected a fragment of artificial debris drifting in the star's orbit. Its construction suggests deep-space design, but any markings or identifiers have long since faded.

§H"I hoped coming here would spark something,"§! she says quietly. §H"But... not yet."§!

options.script: name = UNFORTUNATE

descriptions.zh:
我们的调查团队在§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!星系的残骸中发现了一个漂浮的小型数据水晶。它的外壳已经焦黑，但有一处细节依然清晰可见：一段旧注册码的碎片，字母为§H‘U-N-S’§!。它们的含义尚不明确，但水晶解密后的内容还包括一组精确的坐标。

与此同时，§Y塞拉伦涅§!也找回了另一段记忆。她想起了一个巨大的观景台，星辰在寂静的观察窗外流淌，还有一只指引的手指向一颗蓝色的星球——那是距离其恒星最近的第三颗行星。
descriptions.en:
Our survey team has recovered a small data crystal drifting amid the debris in the §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! system. Its casing is scorched, but one detail remains clear: a fragment of an old registry code, the letters §H'U N S'§!. Their meaning is unclear, but the crystal's decrypted contents also include a set of precise coordinates.

At the same time, §YSeralune§! has recovered another memory. She recalls a vast observation deck, stars spilling across a silent viewport, and a guiding hand pointing toward a blue world, the third planet from its sun.

descriptions.zh:

与此同时，§Y塞拉伦涅§!也找回了另一段记忆。她想起了一个巨大的观景台，星辰在寂静的观察窗外流淌，还有一只指引的手指向一颗蓝色的星球——那是距离其恒星最近的第三颗行星。
descriptions.en:
Our survey team has recovered a small data crystal drifting amid the debris in the §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! system. Its casing is scorched, but one detail remains clear: a fragment of an old registry code, the letters §H'U N S'§!. The resemblance to our own historical markings is uncanny, but the crystal's decrypted contents also include a set of precise coordinates.

At the same time, §YSeralune§! has recovered another memory. She recalls a vast observation deck, stars spilling across a silent viewport, and a guiding hand pointing toward a blue world, the third planet from its sun.

label.zh: 我们必须帮她想起剩下的部分。
label.en: We must help her remember the rest.

options.script: name = nomads.1600.a

label.zh: 她的过去无关紧要。我们已经得到了需要的东西。
label.en: Her past is irrelevant. We have what we need.

descriptions.zh:
§Y塞拉伦涅§!又浮现出了一段记忆。她想起了一座大厅，里面坐满了衣着考究的人，他们低沉而深思熟虑的语调中透着惯于发号施令者的自信。

§H“他们在争论，”§!她低声说道。§H“声音不大，但措辞犀利……是关于一项任务。关于一次必须保密的发射。还有其他的，还有两艘飞船和我们一起出发了。但为什么？我们到底在逃离什么？”§!
descriptions.en:
Another memory has surfaced for §YSeralune§!. She remembers a hall of impeccably dressed figures, their hushed, deliberate tones carrying the confidence of those used to command.

§H"They were arguing,"§! she murmurs. §H"Not loudly, but sharply... about a mission. About a launch that had to stay secret. And there were others, two more ships, sent along with us. But why? Were we running from something?"§!

descriptions.zh:
§Y塞拉伦涅§!浮现出了一段新的记忆。她回想起一艘巨大的世代飞船，其船体旨在承载整个未来。

随后是一次剧烈的震动：警报声响起，远处走廊里金属炸裂的火光闪现。她记得自己被一位女子抱起，带进了一个逃生舱。

§H“她紧紧抱着我。她说我必须活下去……说我太重要了。接着我就孤身一人了。我几乎能看见她的脸庞，但每次它都悄然逝去。”§!
descriptions.en:
A new memory has surfaced for §YSeralune§!. She recalls a vast generational ship, its hull designed to hold entire futures.

Then a violent shudder: alarms, a flash of exploding metal in a distant corridor. She remembers being lifted by a woman and carried to an escape pod.

§H"She held me close. She said I had to survive... that I was too important. And then I was alone. I can almost see her face, but it slips away every time."§!

label.zh: 世代飞船……像我们这艘一样的？

descriptions.zh:
对毁坏方舟舰的分析让我们深入了解了§Y塞拉伦涅§!的起源。其内部结构和生命维持体系与她身上回收的碎片完全吻合。受损的日志中提到了一位指定的继承人，一个自出生起就接受培养、旨在有朝一日领导这艘飞船及其族群的个体。

记录证实，在结构崩解前的几秒钟内，只有一名未成年乘客被撤离。没有其他逃生舱发射。

§H“他们救了我，”§!她轻声说道。§H“我不只是个乘客……我本该领导他们，现在我恳求你帮我理解其中的原因。”§!
descriptions.en:
Analysis of the ruined Arkship has yielded significant insight into §YSeralune§!'s origin. Its internal structure and life-support architecture match her recovered fragments exactly. Corrupted logs reference a designated heir, an individual trained from birth to one day guide the vessel and its people.

Records confirm that only a single juvenile passenger was evacuated seconds before structural failure. No other pods were launched.

§H"They saved me,"§! she says quietly. §H"I wasn't just a passenger... I was meant to lead them, and I implore you now to help me understand the reason why."§!

tooltips.zh: §H塞拉伦涅§!已恢复记忆，并获得了§Y继承恩典§!与§Y合法管理者§!特质。
tooltips.en: §HSeralune§! has recovered her memory, and gained the §YInherited Grace§! and §YRightful Steward§! Traits.

descriptions.zh:
方舟舰已恢复运转，那些沉睡已久的系统立即响应§Y塞拉伦涅§!的出现。修复的数据库证实了她记忆中的猜想：她自幼便接受培养，旨在引导这艘飞船以及曾经生活在其中的子民。

最后一封音频日志幸存了下来。一个沉着而熟悉的女声谈论着继承协议，以及一个必须被保护的孩子。在方舟舰开始瓦解之际，她下令发射了逃生舱。

§H“那个声音……”§!塞拉伦涅低声细语道。§H“我认得它。她曾是……我。或者说我是以她为原型的。一个克隆体……这就是为什么我能活下来。她想要拯救她自己。”§!

无论曾是什么将这艘船带入黑暗，现在它已在我们的旗帜下航行，并由重掌大权的继承人管理。
descriptions.en:
The Arkship is restored, its long-dormant systems immediately responding to §YSeralune§!. Recovered databanks confirm what her memories only suggested: she was raised to guide this vessel and the people who once lived within its hull.

One final audio log survives. A woman's calm, familiar voice speaks of succession protocols and a child who must be protected. She orders the escape pod to launch as the Arkship begins to break apart.

§H"That voice..."§! Seralune whispers. §H"I know it. She was... me. Or I was made from her. A clone... That is why I survived. She wanted to save herself."§!

Whatever carried this ship into the dark, it now flies under our banner, and the stewardship of the heir who has reclaimed it.

options.script: name = nomads.1625.a

descriptions.zh:
随着§Y塞拉伦涅§!的离去，她所承载的脆弱记忆之迹也已归于沉寂。她曾追寻的真相，如今再也无法找回。

她的故事在此终结，虽未完结，但并未被遗忘。
descriptions.en:
With §YSeralune§! gone, the fragile trail of memories she carried has faded into silence. Whatever truths she sought can no longer be recovered.

Her story ends here, unfinished, but not forgotten.

descriptions.en: The delegates from the §H[diplomatic_support_issuer.GetName]§! have arrived at their destination. Their diplomatic visit can now officially begin, and we wish them success in their peaceful endeavors.

descriptions.zh:
为了解决§H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§!的麻烦，一批我们同意负责转移的罪犯搭着运输船已经登上方舟。我们正尽最大努力安全地安置他们，但如此庞大数量的囚犯迟早会惹出麻烦。

我们的合同为我们提供了处理他们的多种选择，但我们不能把他们再次丢在属于§H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§!的星球上。同时，其他帝国很可能也不会喜欢他们的某个殖民地突然涌入大量罪犯。当然，如果我们做得足够隐秘，他们可能永远都不会发现我们到底做了什么。
descriptions.en:
Transport ships carrying the criminals that we have accepted to transfer on behalf of the §H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§! have boarded the arkship. We are doing our best to safely process them, but such a vast amount of prisoners is bound to create trouble at one point or another.

Our Contract gives us options on how to handle them, but we are not supposed to drop them off again on a world belonging to the §H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§!. At the same time, it is likely that other empires will not appreciate a sudden influx of criminals in one of their colonies. Of course, if we are discreet enough, they might never realize what we've been up to.

label.zh: 我们会把他们送到别的地方。
label.en: We'll drop them off somewhere else.

descriptions.zh: 作为我们合约的一部分，最后一批囚犯已经卸客。我们已尽力保持谨慎，但总是存在被发现的风险，且人们在面对突然涌入的外星罪犯时，很少会感到愉快。
descriptions.en: The last prisoners carried as part of our contract have been disembarked. We have tried our best to remain discreet, but detection is always a risk, and people are rarely pleased when faced with a sudden influx of xeno criminals.

descriptions.en: Word of our involvement in the transport of criminal pops has yet to spread. It seems we have not been detected.

descriptions.zh: 我们试图欺骗[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]，但是失败了。虽然罪犯已成功卸载，但我们的行动已被发现，[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]已取消合约并拒绝向我们支付报酬。
descriptions.en: Our attempt at double crossing the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] has failed. While the criminals have been successfully disembarked, we have been detected and the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] has cancelled the contract and refuse to pay us.

descriptions.zh: 虽然我们的行动已被发现，但[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]依然很高兴我们帮他们处理掉了罪犯，并同意向我们全额支付报酬。
descriptions.en: While we have been detected, the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] is still pleased that we rid them of their criminals, and have agreed to pay us in full.

descriptions.zh:
一个旅行团在§H[root.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系登上了方舟舰，一边叽叽喳喳地聊着对旅途的期待一边踏入熙熙攘攘的舰船内舱。

我们订制了一条景色优美的路线，途经若干个值得一去的恒星系供他们游览。现在我们只需要交付好许诺给他们的美景就行了。
descriptions.en:
A group of tourists has boarded the Arkship in the §H[root.solar_system.GetName]§! system, chattering with anticipation as they take in the bustling interior of the vessel.

We have charted a scenic route through several remarkable systems for their enjoyment. Now we need only deliver the spectacle they were promised.

descriptions.en: The tourists enjoyed the sights in the §H[root.solar_system.GetName]§! system, marveling at the wonders around them. They will return home changed, carrying with them first-hand knowledge of the vastness of the universe.

descriptions.zh:
我们遇到的§Y[From.GetName]§!是一个§H游牧§!文明。他们似乎愿意承担我们发布的§H合约§!工作，以换取微薄的费用。

这可能为我们之间的协作提供有趣的契机，我们可以利用他们在轨道开发和探索方面的专业知识来为我们谋利。
descriptions.en:
The §Y[From.GetName]§! we met are a §HNomadic§! civilization. They appear to be willing to pick up §HContract§! work on our behalf in exchange for a modest fee.

This could present interesting opportunities for collaboration between us, and we could leverage their expertise in orbital exploitation and exploration to our benefit.

descriptions.zh:
一个游牧帝国，§Y[nomad_harvesting_deposits_country.GetName]§!，在§Y[nomad_harvested_system.GetName]§!恒星系展开了资源采收行动，正在从我们的储备中提取各类资源，使得这些资源在短期内变得无法继续开采。

面对这种无视我们主权的行为，我们绝不会坐视不理。只要我们下定决心，就能迅速集结舰队，驱逐这些游牧民，并将他们彻底封锁在我们的星域之外。
descriptions.en:
A nomadic empire, the §Y[nomad_harvesting_deposits_country.GetName]§!, has conducted harvesting operations in the §Y[nomad_harvested_system.GetName]§! system and is drawing resources from our deposits, rendering them unprofitable for the near future.

This violation of our sovereignty should probably not go unanswered. Should we wish it so, we could muster our fleets to drive the Nomads off and forbid them access to our space.

descriptions.zh: 方舟舰§Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§!的航程就此结束。经过数年的辛勤劳作，拆除了它的基础设施并将其运下重力井后，我们终于准备好将这艘飞船废弃。我们[event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正在经历一个将被后代铭记的历史时刻。现在，让我们在§Y[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]§!定居吧！
descriptions.en: Thus ends the voyage of the Arkship §Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§!. After years of labor, disassembling its infrastructure and carrying it down the gravity well, we are finally ready to scuttle the ship. We [event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are living through a moment future generations will remember. Now, let us settle §Y[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]§!!

descriptions.zh: 将所有无人机和基础设施从§Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§!转移至一颗[event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon]上，这标志着§Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§!背离了预言中的未来。现在将开发新的优先队列，以适应定居生活。
descriptions.en: The transfer of all drones and infrastructure from the §Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§! to a [event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon] is a departure point from the predicted future of the §Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§!. New priority queues will now be developed to adapt to settled life.

descriptions.zh: 经过多年来对§Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§!基础设施的筹备以及对我们自身生理机能的改造，进化出更强健的骨骼与优化的肺部，如今我们已准备好定居。这将是§Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§!生命周期中的一个全新阶段，也许定居生活会很适合我们。
descriptions.en: After years of preparing the infrastructure of the §Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§! and our own biology, evolving stronger bones and optimized lungs, we are now ready to settle. This will be a new stage in the §Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§! lifecycle, perhaps settled life will suit us.

descriptions.zh:
降落已经完成。有生以来第一次见到起落架踏入土壤时，每一个观察窗前斗挤满了旅客，一阵不整齐的欢呼声震动了船体。几小时内，第一批避难所便由回收的甲板板材搭建而成。孩子们在异星的草地上奔跑，而他们的父母则在开阔的天空下相对无言。

船员们静静地工作着，拆卸下为太空旅行设计的系统，并将它们重新改装以用于地面生存。曾经的一艘游轮，如今成了殖民地的脊梁。

无论好坏，巡游已经结束。
descriptions.en:
The descent is complete. Passengers crowd every viewport as landing struts bite into soil for the first time in living memory, and a ragged cheer shakes the hull. Within hours the first shelters rise from salvaged deck plating. Children run through alien grass while their parents stand speechless under an open sky.

The crew works quietly, unbolting systems built for void travel and repurposing them for groundside survival. What was a cruise ship is now a colony's spine.

For better or worse, the voyage is over.

descriptions.zh:
降落已完成。我们的子个体首次触及土壤，肢体在没有引擎震颤的地面上显得有些不稳。乘客们如潮水般涌出气闸，散布在他们奋力抵达的这片土地上。

集体围绕着行星的律动重新塑形：根系般的补给线向外延伸，取代了原有的走廊物流；营养加工也从船载循环储备转向直接从地景中汲取原始养分。

一个新的家园。蜂群必须存续，一如既往。
descriptions.en:
The descent is complete. Our drones touch soil for the first time, their limbs unsteady on ground that does not thrum with engine vibration. The passengers spill from the airlocks in waves, scattering across the landscape they fought to reach.

The collective reshapes itself around planetary rhythms: root-like supply lines spread to replace corridor logistics, and nutrient processing shifts from recycled shipboard stocks to raw nutrients drawn from the landscape.

A new home. The hive must endure, as it always has.

descriptions.zh:
行星切入完成。着陆装置自出厂以来首次接触地表。旅客正通过所有可用气闸舱撤离，其生物满意度指标处于前所未有的数值。

劳工单元已开始将舰载基础设施转换为地面作业用途。船体外壳正被切割成地基面板，导航阵列正重新校准为地面通信中继站。从真空到陆地运行参数的转变正在无间断推进。

新首要指令：建立并维护殖民地基础设施。
descriptions.en:
Planetary insertion complete. Landing gear has engaged terrain for the first time since original manufacture. Passengers are disembarking via all available airlocks, their biological satisfaction indicators at unprecedented readings.

Worker units have begun converting shipboard infrastructure for surface operations. Hull plating is being sectioned into foundation panels and navigation arrays recalibrated as ground-based communication relays. The transition from void to terrestrial operational parameters is proceeding without interruption.

New primary directive: Establish and maintain colony infrastructure.

descriptions.zh:
自从我们的飞船首次驶出我们的星系以来，我们之中总有一些人只能通过影像记录来了解宇宙，在同一片天空下出生、生活并死去。现在，这一切都将改变。

随着我们的§H方舟舰§!建造完成，引力不再是障碍，宇宙的无数奇迹正等待着我们。§Y[From.GetName]§!已经倾其所有：我们的人民将带着它的名字、它的记忆与它的未来，一同踏入虚空。

§Y[From.GetName]§!在我们身后燃烧，被我们预言已久的灾难所吞没，但我们的人民终于§G获救§!了，乘着一艘§H方舟舰§!的双翼驶入深空。
descriptions.en:
Since our ships first ventured beyond our star, there have always been those among us who knew the cosmos only through recordings, those who were born, lived, and died beneath the same sky. That changes now.

With the completion of our §HArkship§!, gravity is no longer an obstacle, and every wonder of the cosmos awaits. §Y[From.GetName]§! has given all it had to give: our people will carry its name, its memory, and its future with us into the void.

§Y[From.GetName]§! burns behind us, swallowed by the cataclysm we long foretold, but our people are §Gsaved§! at last, cast into the deep on the wings of an §HArkship§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经完成了一艘§H方舟舰§!。我们的无人机将不再被束缚于[From.GetPlanetMoon]。它们的程序已被调整以适应移动星际功能，同时§Y[From.GetName]§!的基础设施已被剥离殆尽，所有必要的系统均已转移，以支持一个全新的、四海为家的未来。

§Y[From.GetName]§!在我们身后燃烧，被我们预言已久的灾难所吞没，但我们的人民终于§G获救§!了，乘着一艘§H方舟舰§!的双翼驶入深空。
descriptions.en:
We have completed an §HArkship§!. No longer will our drones be bound to [From.GetPlanetMoon]. Their processes have been adjusted for mobile stellar function as §Y[From.GetName]§! is stripped bare of infrastructure and all necessary systems are transferred to support a new mobile future.

§Y[From.GetName]§! burns behind us, swallowed by the cataclysm we long foretold, but our people are §Gsaved§! at last, cast into the deep on the wings of an §HArkship§!.

descriptions.zh:

游牧生活与无尽的漫游带给我们的最大回报之一，就是发现新的天地。即使在漫长的旅途之后，依然存在着未曾见过的风景，不论是绝美的还是令人惶恐的。我们的好奇心总是渴望去发掘这些奇观。

然而，对于我们的方舟来说，每一处新景象不仅仅是供其观赏的奇特事物，更是一次学习新知、反思与成长的机会。
descriptions.en:
One of the greatest rewards for nomadism and our ceaseless wandering is the discovery of new places. Even after a long time traveling, there remain sights unseen, beautiful or mortifying. Spectacles that our curiosity yearns to discover.

But more than peculiar things for our arkships to behold, each new vista is an opportunity to learn something new, reflect and grow.

label.zh: 这个星系浩瀚而充满奇迹。
label.en: The galaxy is vast and full of wonders.

descriptions.zh: 在代表§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!执行合同期间，我们偶然发现了一批古老的集装箱。它们被冰块包裹着，我们差点把它们误认为是普通的陨石。虽然从打捞权的角度来看，这些物品在技术上属于我们，但考虑到它们是在为他们工作时发现的，我们应该考虑将它们移交给§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!。扫描这些箱子后，发现里面……
descriptions.en: While working on a contract on behalf of the §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!, we chanced upon a collection of ancient containers. Encased in ice, we almost mistook them for plain asteroids. While technically ours by right of salvage, we should consider turning them over to the §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§! as they were retrieved while working on their behalf. Scanning the crates revealed...

descriptions.zh: 我们方舟舰上的一些老旧模块在一次严重的冷却故障后受损，已经显得老态龙钟。损坏程度很大，好在飞船的完整性受到威胁之前已经进行紧急关停。我们该如何应对？
descriptions.en: Some older modules on our Arkship have begun to show their age after a critical cooling failure left them damaged. The damage is extensive, but an emergency shutdown was triggered before the Arkship's integrity could be compromised. How should we proceed?

label.zh: 没事，反正也到时候替换了。
label.en: It's fine, it was time to replace them anyway.

label.zh: 现在是时候进行一些升级了。
label.en: This is a good time for some upgrades.

label.zh: 别担心，我们有充足的备件。
label.en: No worries, we have plenty of spare parts.
We could make the client pay for it...

descriptions.zh:
在从§Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!装载物资时，我们检测到其中一个货舱发生了收容失效。据报告，安全门另一侧传来了低沉的轰鸣声，证实了舱室内存在潜在危险。

我们要冒险进行调查吗？
descriptions.en:
While loading materials from the §Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!, we detected a containment breach in one of the cargo bays. Deep rumbling noises were reported from the other side of the security doors, confirming the presence of a potential hazard within the compartment.

Should we chance an investigation?

label.zh: 别拿方舟舰冒险，直接把货物抛入太空。
label.en: Let's not risk the Arkship, space the cargo.

descriptions.zh:
货舱门开启后，一群发光生物体令我们措手不及，它们随即窜入了方舟舰的其他区域。异星生物学家的报告显示，这些生物没有攻击性，对我们的公民或飞船的完整性不构成威胁。

这些微小的生物拥有椭圆形的身体，由修长的肢体支撑，能够攀爬墙壁和天花板，并以惊人的速度移动。它们似乎以我们生态系统中的小型害虫为食，利用胸部的发光腺体引诱猎物。居民们已经适应了它们的存在，并发现它们在夜晚格外讨人喜欢——它们发出的光亮和柔和的鸣叫构成了一场令人惬意的奇观。
descriptions.en:
Upon opening the cargo deck doors, a swarm of bioluminescent organisms took us by surprise and scurried in the rest of arkship. Xenobiologist reports indicate that these beings are non-aggressive and pose no threat to our citizens or to the ship's integrity.

The tiny creatures posses an oval shaped body, supported by elongated limbs, and are capable of climbing walls and ceilings while moving at remarkable speed. They appear to feed on small vermin-like critters from our ecosystem, luring them over with bioluminescent glands located in their thorax. Already, inhabitants have gotten used to them, and find them to be especially pleasing at night, when their lights and soft chirps offer a comfortable spectacle.

label.zh: 开始针对它们的生物发光特性进行实验。
让方舟舰的居民尽情享受这奇迹。
label.en: Let the Arkship inhabitants enjoy the wonder.

descriptions.zh:
尽管进行了广泛搜寻，我们的团队仍无法在此时已归于沉寂的货舱中找到骚乱的源头。正当他们准备离开时，一个小生物从阴影中钻了出来，扑向一名船员制服上挂着的一根松散线头。

船员们最初吃惊不小，但很快便判定这只外星生物生性顽皮，并无攻击性。当它被小心翼翼地拿近观察时，这个外星动物发出了一种微弱的、类似马达运转的震动，这被解读为一种表示舒适的良性反应。
descriptions.en:
Despite an extensive search, our team could not isolate the source of the ruckus in the now silent hold. As they prepared to exit, a small creature emerged from the shadows and pounced on a loose strand of fabric hanging from a crewmate's uniform.

Initially startled, the crew soon determined that the alien to be playful in nature, rather than aggressive. When carefully handled for closer inspection the foreign animal emitted a faint, motor-like vibration interpreted as a benign comfort response.

descriptions.zh:
进入货舱后，船员们发现其中一个货运集装箱被从内部破开了。一台受损的机械体瘫在甲板上，电机仍在嗡嗡作响，指示灯紊乱地闪烁着。

船员们试图将该单位放回集装箱，就在这时，一个隐藏隔层打开了，一堆闪烁的水晶散落在地板上。

在永久关机前的一瞬间，机械体发出了一声微弱的低语，据船员报告，其内容为：“别关掉我，我不一样。”
descriptions.en:
Upon entering the cargo deck, the crew discovered that one of the cargo containers had been breached from within. A damaged mechanoid lay sprawled across the deck plating, motors still whirring and indicator lights blinking erratically.

The crew attempted to return the unit to its container, at which point a hidden compartment opened, releasing a collection of shimmering crystals onto the floor.

Immediately prior to its permanent shutdown, the mechanoid emitted a faint vocalization, reported by crew members as: "Don't shut me down, I am different."

label.zh: 我们会将其退还给失主。
label.en: We will send it back to the owner
Scrap it and take the crystals.

descriptions.zh:
靠近货舱时，怪声仍在持续，我们认为采取广泛的安全预防措施极具必要。进入货舱层后，船员们发现舱室内弥漫着强烈的有害异味，并注意到货架碎片散落在停泊区各处。片刻之后，相邻的货柜内发生了几次小型爆炸，引发了紧急响应。

团队循着烟雾痕迹发现了一处小火点。专业人员迅速将其扑灭，使船员能够在事态进一步升级前，安全地控制并中和这些易挥发气体。货舱层出现了明显的结构性损坏，周边区域的多处货箱也遭到了破坏。
descriptions.en:
The weird noises continued when approaching the cargo bay, warranting extensive safety precautions. Upon entry into the cargo deck, crew members detected a strong, noxious odor filling the compartment and noticed pieces of holding crates scattered across the dock. Several minor explosions went off moments later within adjacent cargo containers, prompting an immediate response.

The team followed a trail of smoke, discovering a small fire that had broken out. It was quickly suppressed by specialist personnel, allowing the crew to safely contain and neutralize the volatile gases before further escalation. The cargo deck exhibited visible structural damage, along with multiple nearby crates in the surrounding area.

label.zh: 我们及时阻止了进一步的损害。
label.en: We prevented further damage just in time.
Make the issuer pay for damages.

descriptions.zh:
进入货舱后，骚乱愈演愈烈。声学读数显示源头指向一个货箱。队员们做好了最坏的打算，片刻之后，一个人影从货箱中冲了出来。

此人操着一口浓重且陌生的口音，声称自己带着和平而来。此人自称是§Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§!，并表示[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe]曾是某个庞大舰队组织的一员，后因纪律原因被开除。[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeSheCap]解释说，[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe]潜伏在船上，掩盖[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer]自己的行踪是为了寻求庇护，并渴望有机会证明[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer]的价值。

§Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§!询问队员们是否愿意接受[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHisHer]提议。
descriptions.en:
Upon entering the cargo bay, the disturbance intensifies. Acoustic readings trace the source to a single cargo crate. The team prepares for the worst as, moments later, an individual bursts free from its confinement.

They claim to come in peace, speaking with a pronounced and unfamiliar accent. They identify themselves as §Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§! and state that [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe] was once part of a larger fleet organization before being expelled for disciplinary reasons. [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeSheCap] explains that [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe] concealed [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer]self aboard the vessel in search of safety and an opportunity to prove [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer] usefulness.

§Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§! asks whether the team is willing to accept [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHisHer] proposal.

label.zh: 对我们来说，你不过是货物。我们会按要求把你送到。
label.en: You're nothing but cargo to us. We will deliver you as required.

label.zh: 送你回到你该去的地方吧，叛徒。
label.en: Let's send you back to where you came from, traitor.

descriptions.zh:
当舱门打开时，那些异常的噪音戛然而止。由于无法确定骚乱的原因，团队开始对货物集装箱进行系统扫描。

其中一个集装箱显示出多个意料之外的生命体征。强行打开后，发现其中有几个人，明显营养不良，身体状况极差。“请发发慈悲，”其中一人说道。“我们遭到了迫害，被迫从§Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!帝国逃亡。我们听凭您的发落。”
descriptions.en:
The anomalous noises cease immediately when the doors open. Unable to determine the cause of the disturbance, the team begins a systematic scan of the cargo containers.

One of them registers multiple unexpected life signatures. Breaking it open reveals several individuals, visibly malnourished and in poor physical condition. "Please, have mercy," says one. "We were persecuted and forced to flee from §Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§! Empire. We submit ourselves to whatever fate you deem appropriate."

label.zh: 我们应该把他们遣送回去。
告诉我们你所知道的，我们会带你前往目的地。
label.en: Tell us what you know and we will bring you to your destination.

label.zh: 我们的方舟舰上还有空余位置。
label.en: We have space on the Arkship.

descriptions.zh:
在我们与§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。他们希望在合约有效期内记录方舟舰的运作情况。

他们的既定目标是研究一个在常规行星参数之外运行的移动自治网络，关于这一课题目前几乎没有外部数据可供参考。
descriptions.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!. They wish to document Arkship operations during the active contract period.

Their stated objective is the study of a mobile autonomous network operating outside conventional planetary parameters, a subject for which little external data exists.

descriptions.zh:
在我们与§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。他们要求在合约有效期内获得在方舟舰上的观察权。

该请求源自个体研究人员，他们试图理解一种超出其记录经验的集体移动生存方式。
descriptions.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!. They are requesting observation rights aboard the Arkship during the active contract period.

The request originates from individuated researchers seeking to comprehend a form of collective mobile existence outside their documented experience.

descriptions.zh:
在我们与§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。他们希望在合约有效期内观察并记录方舟舰上的生活。

似乎对大多数定居文明而言，游牧的生活方式依然令人着迷，且充满着不小的神秘感。
descriptions.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!. They wish to observe and document life aboard the Arkship during the active contract period.

It seems that to most settled civilizations, the nomadic way of life remains a subject of fascination and no small degree of mystery.

label.zh: 给予有限权限，但是得给钱。
label.en: Grant limited access, for a fee.

label.zh: 方舟不是可供观赏的游乐场。
label.en: The Arkship is not a spectacle.

descriptions.zh:
在我们与§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

相互冲突的优先指令导致两个管理子系统之间出现了处理冲突。

双方均将自身标记为当前合约的授权操作单位，导致系统陷入循环待机状态，从而降低了产出效率。
descriptions.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!.

Competing priority directives have caused a processing conflict between two management subsystems.

Each has flagged itself as the authorized operational unit for our current contract, resulting in a recursive standby loop that is reducing output efficiency.

descriptions.zh:
在我们与§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

集合体的运作共振中出现了一个不和谐的线程。

关于当前合约内的责任划分，两个子集群开始发出相互冲突的行为模式，为共享意识引入了低效因素。
descriptions.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!.

A dissonant thread has emerged within the collective's operational resonance.

Two sub-clusters have begun emitting conflicting behavioral patterns regarding the delineation of responsibilities within our current contract, introducing an inefficiency into the shared consciousness.

descriptions.zh:
在我们与§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

两个船员部门之间出现了关于哪个团队拥有操作权限的管辖权争议。双方均已提交正式投诉，受影响区域的工作效率已开始下降。
descriptions.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!.

A jurisdictional dispute has emerged between two crew departments over which team holds operational authority. Both have submitted formal complaints, and productivity in the affected area has begun to suffer.

label.en: We don't have time for this.

descriptions.zh:
在我们与§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

诊断周期发现，多个主次系统积累了大量延期的维护任务。效率预测表明，安排一次定期维护将使劳动力产出获得具有统计学意义的显著提升。

该报告已提交给[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]，其将密切关注此事的处理情况，并势必会要求修改条款。
descriptions.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!.

Diagnostic cycles have flagged an accumulation of deferred maintenance tasks across several primary and secondary systems. Efficiency projections indicate a statistically significant improvement to workforce output would follow a scheduled maintenance period.

The report has been flagged to [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], who will be monitoring how the matter is handled, and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

descriptions.zh:
在我们与§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

我们记录到了我们的低级子个体中日益严重的不协调现象。它们的劳作过程需要一段同步恢复期，因为持续的压制有导致集体产出出现显著下降的风险。

[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]已获悉此情况，并且必然会要求修订条款。
descriptions.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!.

We have registered a growing dissonance within our Simple Drones. Their labor processes requires a period of synchronized recovery, as continued suppression risks measurable decline in collective output.

[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName] has been made aware of the situation and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

descriptions.zh:
在我们与§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

方舟舰的内部监控系统报告称，劳工阶层船员的士气出现恶化。一份要求获得一段休整期的正式请求已被提交。

该请求已抄送至[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]，对方正等待回复，并必然会要求修改条款。
descriptions.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!.

The Arkship's internal monitoring systems have flagged a deterioration in crew morale among the worker strata. A formal request for a period of rest has been submitted.

The request has been copied to [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], who will expect a response and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

tooltips.zh: §R这份合约的完成时报酬将减少25%。§!
tooltips.en: §RThis contract's completion payout will be reduced by 25%.§!

descriptions.zh:
在我们与§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

我们在已完成合同中记录的运营数据已被外部观察者获取。§H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!在追踪该区域的自主网络活动时，注意到了我们的效率指标，并认为我们是一家可靠且有实力的承包商。

通讯频道已建立。我们可以接受这一评价，或者将功劳转交给我们的现有合作伙伴。
descriptions.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!.

Operational data logged across completed contracts has been accessed by external observers. §H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!, tracking autonomous network activity in the region, has flagged our efficiency metrics as consistent with a reliable and capable contractor.

A channel has been established. We may acknowledge the assessment, or redirect attribution to our existing partners.

descriptions.zh:
在我们与§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

在观察整个星域的贸易与劳动力流动时，§H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!注意到了我们行动中的规律，这彰显了我们的可靠与能力。

认可的共鸣已经到来。我们可以予以回应，或者让其他蜂巢主脑的声音将这一信号传递下去。
descriptions.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!.

§H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!, observing the flow of trade and labor across the sector, has recognized a pattern in our movements, one that speaks to reliability and capability.

The resonance of recognition has arrived. We may answer it, or let another voice carry the signal forward.

descriptions.zh:
在我们与§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

我们作为承包商的良好业绩已声名远播。§H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!在监控泛星系贸易活动时注意到了这一点，现在将我们视为一个可靠且有能力的合作伙伴。

我们现在有机会进一步培养这份关系，或者也可以将功劳让给我们自己信任的合作伙伴。
descriptions.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!.

Word of our track record as a contractor has traveled. §H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!, monitoring galactic trade activity, has taken note, and now views us as a reliable and capable partner.

An opening exists to cultivate the relationship, or possibly to defer credit to our own trusted partners.

label.zh: 向他们保证我们的善意。
label.en: Assure them of our good intentions.

label.zh: 好名声就是它自己最好的回报。
label.en: A good reputation is its own reward.

对合约所涉及区域的初步和远程扫描已证实富有成效。数据具有相当大的商业价值，一位独立经纪人已主动提出全面收购。
